title: kx-plot: one-line matplotlib plots
subtitle: One-line matplotlib plots and themes for Kaggle notebooks
description:
**kx**: tiny, transparent matplotlib helper for Kaggle notebooks that works offline.

## Setup
Attach this dataset (**Add Data → kx-plot**), then:
```python
import sys; sys.path.append('/kaggle/input/datasets/vhrabar/kx-plot')
import kx; kx.use('dark')
```

## One-liner plots
```python
kx.plot(x, y, z, "scatter-dark-grid")    # spec: kind-theme-flag-...
kx.plot(x, y, "bar-light-leg")           # z is optional
```
- **kind**: line | step | area | band | scatter | bar | hist
- **theme**: dark | light | paper (any file in `kx/styles/`)
- **flags**: grid | leg | logx | logy | tight | stack | norm (stack, norm: area only)

Unknown tokens raise an error. Run `kx.grammar()`, `kx.show('dark')` or `kx.source()` to see exactly what everything does.

## Contents
- `kx/`: the helper package (`import kx`), with theme files in `kx/styles/` and demo CSVs for `kx.load()` in `kx/data/`
- `previews/`: one PNG per theme and a demo notebook

Source and issues: https://github.com/vhrabar/kx-plot
